name: Kurano Sae
source: The twins mother. Tired of her husband's constant mistakes in running the shop she threatens divorce and leaves. All she needs to be successful is [url=https://vndb.org/c20865]Kazuya[/url], whom she has taught everything but his sisters won't let him leave without them. He has a month to decide which.
